Fetch any numeric features of the cells: genes, metadata or embeddings

Source: R/seurat_data.R
fetch_plot_values.Rd

Used by plots that accept a mix of genes and per-cell values (violin, ridge and heatmap plots). From a Seurat object, metadata columns (QC metrics, module scores) are read as they are; genes are read from one assay, keyed so that they never come from another one (fetch_features()), and the assay and layer are reported only when at least one feature is a gene. Genes missing from the assay are left out with a warning that names near matches in case (genes_in_assay()). From a data frame (e.g. a table of QC metrics), features are its columns.

Usage

fetch_plot_values(object, features, cells, assay, slot)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object, or a data frame with one row per cell

features

Feature names

cells

Cell names (Seurat object) or row names / indices (data frame), in the order wanted

assay

Assay name, or NULL for the default assay

slot

Layer to read genes from

Value

A list with `data` (a data frame, one column per feature found and one row per cell), `is_gene` (logical, named by feature) and `assay` (the result of resolve_assay(), or NULL when no feature is a gene)
